description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin named 'filebrowser' that adds support for file uploads and browsing within the editor. It includes functions for constructing URLs with query parameters, handling file selection, and attaching file browser functionality to dialog elements. The code manages configuration options for external file browser URLs, upload URLs, and window features, and sets up event handlers for dialog definition to integrate file browsing features.

methods.name: addQueryString
methods.description: Adds additional query parameters to a URL.

methods.name: ucFirst
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to uppercase.

methods.name: browseServer
methods.description: Opens the file browser popup for server browsing.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Handles the upload process, checking if a file is selected.

methods.name: setupFileElement
methods.description: Configures the file input element with appropriate URL and settings.

methods.name: attachFileBrowser
methods.description: Attaches file browser functionality to dialog elements with 'filebrowser' attribute.

methods.name: updateTargetElement
methods.description: Updates the target input element with the selected file URL.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a filebrowser URL is configured for a given dialog element.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the selected file into the target element, calling optional callbacks.
